chunks: Abu Abdillah al-Husayn ibn Muhammad al-Ushnani al-Razi the Judge in Balkh narrated to us, saying: Ali ibn Mihrwayh al-Qazwini narrated to us, from Dawud ibn Sulayman al-Farra' (thus), from Ali ibn Musa al-Rida, from his father, from his forefathers, from Ali (peace be upon them), who said: The Messenger of Allah said:

Verily, when Musa ibn 'Imran whispered to his Lord saying, 'O my Lord, are You far from me so I may shout to You or are You close to me so I may whisper to You?' Therefore, Allah, Lofty be His Majesty, revealed to him, 'I am in the Gathering of whoever remembers Me.' So Musa asked, 'O my Lord, in what state shall I remember You?' Thus, He replied, 'O Musa, remember Me in every state.'

key_terms.نَاجَى: to converse privately / to whisper in prayer

ai.seo_question: What did Allah reveal to Musa about His proximity when Musa asked if He was far or near?
ai.summary: In Shaykh al-Saduq’s *al-Tawhid*, this hadith illustrates the concept of *Qurb* (proximity) as a spiritual state rather than a physical location, aligning with the Shia theological negation of space (*Makan*) for the Divine. The dialogue highlights that God’s presence is contingent upon the believer's remembrance (*Dhikr*), offering a practical framework for maintaining spiritual awareness across all life circumstances.

en.sayed-ali-raza-rizvi: 17. Abu `Abd Allah al-Husayn ibn Muhammad al-Ushnani al-Rzai the Judge in Balkh said: `Ali ibn Mihrwayh al-Qazwini said, on the authority of Dawud ibn Sulayman al-Farra’, on the authority of `Ali ibn Musa al-Rida (AS), on the authority of his father, on the authority of his forefathers on the authority of `Ali (AS) that The Messenger of Allah said:

Verily, when Musa ibn `Imran whispered to his Lord saying, “O my Lord, are You far from me so I may shout to You or are You close to me so I may whisper to You?” Therefore, Allah, Lofty be His Majesty, revealed to him, “I am in the Gathering of whoever remembers Me.” So Musa (AS) asked, “O my Lord, in what state shall I remember you?” Thus, He replied, “O Musa, remember Me in every state.”
